axisLength.doc: Default axis length in world units.

defaultAxisLineThickness.doc: Default axis line thickness in screen-space logical pixels.

secondaryAxisThicknessScale.doc: Secondary-frame axis thickness relative to the world axis thickness.

defaultAxisLabelSize.doc: Default axis label size. The fallback where no theme supplies one.

axisLabelOffsetPixels.doc: Screen-space offset from an axis endpoint to its label center.

calloutGapPixels.doc: Gap between the anchor point and the start of the angled leader segment.

calloutAngledLengthPixels.doc: Length of the angled leader segment.

calloutHorizontalLengthPixels.doc: Length of the horizontal leader segment.

calloutAngleDegrees.doc: Angle of the angled leader segment from horizontal.

calloutLeaderLineWidth.doc: Callout leader line width in screen-space logical pixels.

calloutBorderThickness.doc: Callout border width. Tied to the leader width: at thinner widths, horizontal and vertical lines antialias differently.

calloutLabelPixelSize.doc: Screen-pixel size of the callout label.

calloutOpacityNearDistance.doc: Distance at or below which a callout has maximum opacity.

calloutOpacityFarDistance.doc: Distance at or above which a callout has minimum opacity.

calloutOpacityMax.doc: Callout opacity at the near distance.

calloutOpacityMin.doc: Callout opacity at the far distance.

markerDiameterPixels.doc: Default marker diameter in screen-space logical pixels.

markerSubdivisions.doc: Icosphere subdivision level of the marker mesh. Each level quadruples the icosahedron's 20 triangles.

scaleBarCorner.doc: Default viewport corner of the scale bar overlay. Bottom-left, where a reader looks for a drawing's scale. Codes: 0 top-left, 1 top-right, 2 bottom-left, 3 bottom-right.

scaleBarOffsetXPixels.doc: Default horizontal offset of the scale bar overlay from its corner, toward the viewport center.

scaleBarOffsetYPixels.doc: Default vertical offset of the scale bar overlay from its corner, toward the viewport center.

scaleBarWidthPixels.doc: Default width of the scale bar overlay.

scaleBarHeightPixels.doc: Default height of the scale bar overlay.

scaleBarMinTickSpacingPixels.doc: Least distance between adjacent scale bar ticks. The bar subdivides into the most clean parts that keep its ticks this far apart.

scaleBarStepHysteresis.doc: Fraction of the scale bar's maximum length that a longer step must clear before the bar adopts it, so the value does not flicker at a step boundary.

scaleBarLabelHeightPixels.doc: Pixel height of the scale bar's value label.

colorRampLegendCorner.doc: Default viewport corner of the color ramp legend overlay. Bottom-right, clear of the scale bar and the navigation cube. Codes: 0 top-left, 1 top-right, 2 bottom-left, 3 bottom-right.

colorRampLegendOffsetXPixels.doc: Default horizontal offset of the color ramp legend overlay from its corner, toward the viewport center.

colorRampLegendOffsetYPixels.doc: Default vertical offset of the color ramp legend overlay from its corner, toward the viewport center.

colorRampLegendWidthPixels.doc: Default width of the color ramp legend overlay.

colorRampLegendHeightPixels.doc: Default height of the color ramp legend overlay.

navigationCubeCorner.doc: Default viewport corner of the navigation cube overlay. Top-right, where CAD tools place their view cube. Codes: 0 top-left, 1 top-right, 2 bottom-left, 3 bottom-right.

navigationCubeOffsetXPixels.doc: Default horizontal offset of the navigation cube overlay from its corner, toward the viewport center.

navigationCubeOffsetYPixels.doc: Default vertical offset of the navigation cube overlay from its corner, toward the viewport center.

navigationCubeWidthPixels.doc: Default width of the navigation cube overlay.

navigationCubeHeightPixels.doc: Default height of the navigation cube overlay.

groundGridMinLineSpacingPixels.doc: Smallest screen distance between neighboring minor ground-grid lines, measured at the camera target.

groundGridStepMargin.doc: Fraction by which the minor line spacing passes a step boundary before the ground grid changes step, and passes back before it changes back.

groundGridMaxLinesPerAxis.doc: Most ground-grid lines across the patch in each direction. A finer minor step coarsens until the lines fit.

groundGridFadeSegments.doc: Segments each ground-grid line splits into, each with its own opacity, so the line fades toward the patch edge.

groundGridMinorLineWidth.doc: Width of a minor ground-grid line in screen-space logical pixels.

groundGridMajorLineWidth.doc: Width of a major ground-grid line in screen-space logical pixels.

groundGridLabelPixelSize.doc: Pixel height of a ground-grid coordinate label.
